fee_notes: Includes $6,000 allocated to a subscription plan for training and MAPS coaching programs. Additional required fees: Franchise Systems Orientation registration ($399 per person, typically 3-5 people) and Technology Fee ($250). Fee is fully earned and nonrefundable.
